candidates.name: Holman, Inc.
candidates.reason: Its toilet partitions page says it sells and installs toilet partitions with its own in-house crew for business owners and general contractors. The same page lists Flagler County and Volusia County among the counties it serves. Jacksonville is about 90 miles from Daytona Beach.
candidates.partition_evidence: The toilet-partitions page describes the steps from site measurement by its installation team to an in-house crew install and punch list. The portfolio shows photos of restroom stalls.
candidates.review_source: Google, as quoted on its own site ('4.9 Stars 60+ Google Reviews'); not checked on Google
red_flags: Sells partitions directly in many brands, including ASI, Bobrick, Bradley, Metpar, Scranton and AAMCO (buy-around risk)
The site shows a second phone number in the footer: 904-781-4531
